sections.Profile:
Basketball, produced by Ideas y Diseños, Sociedad Anónima (IDSA) in 1986, is a solid-state pinball machine themed around the sport of basketball. The game accommodates up to four players and features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, and 14 standup targets.

- Manufacturer: Ideas y Diseños, Sociedad Anónima
- Years made: 1986
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Basketball, Sports, Solid State, 1980s
